description: Create (or fetch the existing) direct-message channel with one or more users (ClickUp Chat v3). Returns the DM channel. Use before sending a private message to specific people.

team_id.description: Team/Workspace ID. Falls back to CLICKUP_TEAM_ID when omitted.

user_ids.description: User ids to include in the direct-message conversation (1 for a 1:1 DM, more for a group DM).

name: create_chat_direct_message
